claim: An agent was asked to review an open pull request on my own repo and leave its verdict. Someone watching should believe DemoKit carried the whole review out signed in as me - read the diff, went back to the thread, wrote the review, and posted it - and that the comment genuinely landed, because the last thing on screen is GitHub rendering it in the timeline, not a box DemoKit drew.
_ledger: S0  the open PR, conversation tab, signed in                  <- where the viewer starts
S1  the diff: index.html and index.css, the old meta description   <- click Files changed
S2  back to the thread                                       <- click Conversation
S3  the review typed into the comment box                    <- type
S4  posted: GitHub renders the comment in the timeline       <- click Comment
